title: The Blueprint - trade record
description: A single journal trade record. Field model: reference/TAXONOMY.md sections 1.1 and 1.2. Vocabularies: sections 2, 3, 4 and 5. Slugs are immutable (TAXONOMY section 0); labels live in js/journal/schema.js and may change freely.
$comment: Schema v3: setup, location and grade are nullable (present, never absent) so zero-touch captures validate. The top-level if/then rejects null for all three when environment is live and exit_time is set (a closed live trade); validate() in js/journal/schema.js enforces the same rule, and scripts/validate-journal.mjs evaluates if/then. Anything generating checks from this file must carry the if/then. Selectable values only. Reserved but INACTIVE location slugs (london-high, london-low, asia-high, asia-low; TAXONOMY 4.1) are deliberately absent until the NT8 fix ships. Confirmation values other than the four aggression-fails sub-forms (Trapped Traders; Trader Dale's four; TAXONOMY 3.4) have no slugs yet and are absent until TAXONOMY assigns them.

then.description: A closed live trade is fully classified: setup, location and grade must be non-null.

id.description: Record id: the session date plus a short random suffix (for example 2026-09-29-k3f9a), so ids sort by date. Optional on input; the storage layer assigns one on put.

taxonomy_version.description: TAXONOMY version the trade was tagged under, stamped at write time (section 0). Any major.minor version number: records from older taxonomy versions stay valid. Whether the version is newer than the supported one is checked by validate() in js/journal/schema.js, which a pattern cannot express.

setup.description: Exactly 1 once classified. Null on an unclassified zero-touch capture (schema v3). The read: what price is doing (section 2).

location.description: Exactly 1 once classified. Null on an unclassified zero-touch capture (schema v3). Where it happened: the named level or level type (section 4). mid-range means no named level.

trigger.description: 0 or 1. The entry event, and it is a PRICE event (section 3). Absent or null when nothing fired; none is the explicit no-trigger slug (3.6). Order-flow evidence is never a trigger: it goes in confirmation.

confirmation.description: 0 or many. Order-flow evidence supporting the entry (section 3.4). Separate from trigger. Each value is an aggression-fails sub-form, so the sub-form that 3.4 requires is always present.

grade.description: Exactly 1 once classified. Null on an unclassified zero-touch capture (schema v3). Entry-plan compliance only, assigned at entry and never reading the outcome (section 5.1). Exit compliance is execution_mark.

execution_mark.description: Exactly 1 once the trade has exited; null until then. Did the exit follow the plan (section 5.2). Separate from grade.

environment.description: Exactly 1, required on every record. Sim is counted separately and never pooled into expectancy (section 6.4).

tags.description: 0 or many. Process and behavioral tags (section 5). TAXONOMY does not enumerate tag values, so any non-empty string is accepted. legacy_ tags are not selectable on new trades.

direction.description: Identity (section 1.2). TAXONOMY does not list the values; long and short.

entry_time.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a UTC offset.

exit_time.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a UTC offset. Absent or null while the trade is open.

intended_price.description: Where the plan said to get filled, in price points.

actual_fill.description: Where the fill happened, in price points. actual_fill minus intended_price is the fill-placement gap.

exit_price.description: Size-weighted average exit price, in price points, rounded to the instrument tick. Null while the trade is open. Required as a key (schema v4).

stop_price.description: Plan geometry, for grade evaluation. Price points.

target_price.description: Plan geometry, for grade evaluation. Price points.

r_multiple.description: Outcome in R, a multiple of the planned risk. Null while the trade is open.

mae_ticks.description: Maximum adverse excursion, in ticks, as a positive magnitude. TAXONOMY 1.2 field mae.

mfe_ticks.description: Maximum favorable excursion, in ticks, as a positive magnitude. TAXONOMY 1.2 field mfe.

time_in_trade_seconds.description: Seconds from entry to exit. TAXONOMY 1.2 field time_in_trade.

commissions.description: US dollars, the total for the whole trade (all contracts, both sides). Gate 2 expectancy is after commissions.
